entries.change: Presentation: the full catalogue moved to the foot of the page and is now one line per benchmark, paged. Result tables open at 6 benchmarks by 12 models with controls to widen, and a column whose benchmark reports several metrics now carries a metric picker instead of silently showing one.

Fixed a model-registry gap that silently dropped the pure speech-LM family (TWIST, LAST, pGSLM, dGSLM, GSLM, AudioLM, Spectron, SpiRit-LM Expressive) — the family that likelihood-based benchmarks actually evaluate. SALMon went from 1 model to 8; 152 result cells and 17 models recovered overall.
Recall pass over an independently harvested arXiv pool (25,446 speech-relevant records via OAI-PMH) added 91 benchmarks that keyword-driven discovery had missed.
Result tables constrained to one metric per column, with a scale-collision guard that separates 1-5 judge scores from the same metric normalised to 100.
Atlas published: 360 benchmarks, 19 capability categories, arXiv timeline, and model-by-benchmark tables with 2,433 sourced result cells.
